annotations.title: Mark a saved note as used (legacy alias)

description: Legacy alias of mark_skwirl_used; prefer mark_skwirl_used. Record that a Skwirl note shaped the user's work, decision or action; use only when the user asks to record that they applied it. Uses an exact note_id from search_stash, recent_stash or list_stash_mentions. Sets status to used and replaces used_at with the current timestamp; tracks use and changes status-filter results, with no search-ranking boost. Repeating keeps status used but refreshes the timestamp, so it is not fully idempotent. Returns 'Marked as used.' or a no-match message for a missing or inaccessible ID; note content is retained. Usage examples: mark_stash_used({"note_id":"a1b2c3d4e5f67890"}). Returns text.

note_id.description: Nonempty string ID returned by search_stash, recent_stash or list_stash_mentions; use it verbatim. Example: a1b2c3d4e5f67890.
